notes.title: Decodence - Early Access Launch on June 30th!
notes.notes:
[p]We're excited to announce that [i]Decodence [/i]will launch in [b]Early Access on June 30th, 2025!

[/b]Jump into fast-paced multiplayer battles and experience engaging combat, alongside versatile movement.[/p][p][/p][p]We're developing [i]Decodence [/i]with our community closely in mind and look forward to hearing your feedback as we continue build the ultimate movement shooter.

This is just the start and with your support, we will be adding new weapons, game modes, maps, features, and optimizations regularly.[/p][p][/p][p]Want more ways to stay up to date or have questions? Join our Discord server, where you can ask questions or see things like game server status.[/p][p]Add [i]Decodence [/i]to your Wishlist and get ready to jump into action!

See you in-game soon![/p]
